messages:
sylvia: Heads-up: EU canary gen route showing spikes of 503s since 12:07 UTC. Anyone know a quick saved-search pattern to slice by org/model/route so I can hand off to oncall?

logan: Try filtering service+org+model+status. I usually start broad then narrow. Example:
```
service:inference-eu AND org:acme AND model:"gpt-4o-mini" AND route:gen/* AND http.status_code:503
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 500
```
If nothing, try `status:503` or `status_code:503` depending on ingestion.

kevin: FWIW we have a team saved search but it's under my personal list. I'll push a shared one and link it here.

kevin: created shared saved search -> https://dash.redwood.internal/logs/saved/eu-gen-503-org-model. Name: `sre-eu-gen-503`. Filters: `service:inference-eu org:* model:* route:gen/* http.status_code:503`

ops-bot: Saved search `sre-eu-gen-503` created by kevin. Shared with `eng-sre`. Link: https://dash.redwood.internal/logs/saved/eu-gen-503-org-model

sylvia: awesome, can you also add retention 30d and tag `canary`? Helps for runbooks.

kevin: done. retention=30d, tags=[canary,eu]. Also pinned to eng-sre saved searches collection.

marco: suggestion: add `env:canary` and maybe `deploy.tag:*` to rule out rollout-caused noise. For alerts, consider a suppress window for deploys and then alert if >=40% 503s over 5m.

logan: Agreed. If you want I can draft a Prometheus-ish alert expression for rate-based detection and a corresponding log-signal alert.

sylvia: please draft and post here, thanks all :thumbsup:
